system.description:
Lore: Relic Amulet (Bound)

Found in the Black Cabin, where Macreadus apparently valued it less than his machine. It has the following Powers:

  • Vigour: The wearer's Might score becomes 19 if it isn't already higher.

Value: 10000g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
